title: Holidays Around the World
text:
In Japan, many people celebrate New Year in January. They visit temples and eat special food. Families often clean their homes before the new year starts.

In Mexico, people celebrate the Day of the Dead on November 1 and 2. Families put flowers on the graves of their loved ones. It is a happy day to remember family and friends.

questions.text: When do many people in Japan celebrate New Year?
What do Mexican families put on the graves?
Why do families clean their homes before New Year in Japan?
options: They are going on a trip
They want to sell the house
They want the home to be ready for the new year

questions.text: How do people in Mexico probably feel about the Day of the Dead?
options: They feel happy and remember loved ones

Meksika'da insanlar Ölüler Günü'nü 1 ve 2 Kasım'da kutlar. Aileler sevdiklerinin mezarlarına çiçekler koyar. Aile ve arkadaşları hatırlamak için mutlu bir gündür.
